scripts.build: pnpm --filter @inklayer/extension build && pnpm --filter @inklayer/viewer build && pnpm --filter @inklayer/review build
scripts.api:generate: pnpm dlx openapi-typescript@7.13.0 packages/api/openapi.json -o packages/api/src/schema.d.ts --root-types --root-types-no-schema-prefix --default-non-nullable false
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/api && tsc -p packages/overlay && tsc -p packages/ui && tsc -p packages/docs && tsc -p apps/extension && tsc -p apps/viewer && tsc -p apps/site && tsc -p apps/review && tsc -p test
